findings.title: getJson has no in-repo callers; betaBanner flag inside it is always true
findings.note: No file in src imports getJson (checked index.ts, checkout, cart, tests). betaBanner is hardcoded true in flags.ts with no code path setting it false, so the isEnabled check inside this already-uncalled function can never take more than one value.

findings.title: client-admin.ts exports are never called; adminPanel flag key does not exist
findings.note: getAdminJson and adminEnabled have zero in-repo callers (highest hotspot score in repo) despite recent churn. adminPanel is not a key in FLAGS, so adminEnabled() falls through to '?? false' and can never return true even if called.

findings.title: newCheckout flag hardcoded off, checkout branch unreachable

evidence.quote:
// newCheckout has been off since launch; the new flow was never finished
  newCheckout: false,

findings.note: FLAGS is a static object with no runtime configuration source, and the comment confirms the new flow was abandoned, so this branch cannot execute; it is dead code standing in for a feature that was never finished.

findings.title: Deprecated legacyFormat wrapper still called from checkout
findings.note: legacyFormat is marked @deprecated in favor of formatMoney, but checkout.ts still calls it on its only live path (the legacy branch, since newCheckout is permanently off), so the deprecated unit is not actually unused.

open_questions.question: Is this module meant to be a public/plugin entry point consumed by code outside this repo, given the package has no 'main'/'exports' field to confirm or rule that out?
Same question as client.ts: no in-repo caller was found for getAdminJson or adminEnabled, and there is no external-surface declaration to check against.
